format: ONNX opset 17, input image[1,1,H,W] grey 0..1 (H,W multiples of 16), outputs heat[1,4,H/4,W/4] (sigmoid), size[1,2,..] log(w/4),log(h/4), offset[1,2,..]
domain: plan symbols only: tables, chairs, columns. Not rooms, not numbers, not capacity.

training.data: synthetic banquet plans (training/synth.py generation 2, styles other than 8,9) only; no real plan; warm-started from v1

thresholds.chosenOn: fixed a priori: 0.5 for every class (the sigmoid midpoint), NOT tuned on any plan
thresholds.why: Calibration on synthetic plans did not transfer: on held-out synthetic styles a 0.95 precision target picked 0.2 and a 0.995 target picked ~0.75 for tables, while real plans score differently. Tuning on Golden/ORNEK would tune on the test venues, so the threshold is fixed in advance and reported as such.

notes: Its new-venue quality is the cross-venue folds in benchmarks/offline-intelligence/, not its score on plans it was trained on.
